primitives.name: False Claim Propagation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **False claim propagation**: Automated media can distribute a bad pick claim (a fabricated win rate, a "lock" framing) to thousands of followers before an operator can intervene.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'claim integrity dimensionless score', 'T': 'time in seconds', 'N': 'number of followers'}
primitives.assumptions: Automated systems operate without temporal delay between generation and dissemination; human review latency is finite and bounded.
primitives.breakdown_regime: C(T) → 0 as T → ∞ under unmonitored propagation

layer2.mapping: GSI's claim integrity model maps C(T) to posterior probability of misinformation spread; GSE enforces operator gateways to prevent C(T) < threshold.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of unauthorized content distribution and user engagement metrics

primitives.name: Copyright Exposure
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Copyright exposure**: Automated content that ingests sports footage, music, or imagery from unlicensed sources creates immediate legal liability.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'legal liability risk index', 'F': 'footage usage frequency', 'M': 'music library licensing status'}
primitives.assumptions: Unlicensed ingestion triggers DMCA or similar legal action; licensing is binary (present/absent).
primitives.breakdown_regime: L(F,M) → ∞ when F > 0 and M = false

layer2.mapping: GSI evaluates L(F,M) via digital asset tracking; GSE blocks unlicensed ingestion paths.
layer2.telemetry: Number of unlicensed media assets processed and flagged

primitives.name: Brand Safety Failure
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Brand safety failures**: Auto-generated thumbnails or social graphics that use casino imagery, tout vocabulary, or real-athlete deepfakes can permanently damage the platform's positioning.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B': 'brand safety score', 'I': 'imagery type (casino=1, athlete=2, etc.)', 'V': 'vocabulary category (touts=1, etc.)'}
primitives.assumptions: Brand safety is a categorical function of visual/audio content types; deepfakes are detectable but not always flagged.
primitives.breakdown_regime: B(I,V) < 0 when I ∈ {casino, athlete_deepfake} or V ∈ {touts}

layer2.mapping: GSI models B(I,V) as a classification risk; GSE enforces content filtering rules to prevent B < 0 states.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of brand-violating content detected and removed

Each domain is modeled as a function of time, content type, and platform compliance. False claim propagation is a Markovian decay in trustworthiness over time without operator oversight. Copyright exposure scales with unlicensed media ingestion, forming a discontinuous risk surface. Brand safety failure occurs when content violates semantic norms, creating a non-linear degradation in platform reputation. The policy enforces a dual-layered control: GSI’s Bayesian inference models these risks dynamically, while GSE enforces deterministic access control to prevent unsafe states. The failure modes are defined by thresholds in each domain: C(T) < 0, L(F,M) = ∞, B(I,V) < 0. These are dualized into operational constraints: no auto-upload, no unlicensed use, and no AI-generated misleading content. The system is designed to maintain a safe operating region in risk space through human-in-the-loop validation gates.
